doctor_rx_modules_label_length.name: doctor_rx_modules_label_length
doctor_rx_modules_label_length.value: print_label is null or (btrim(print_label) <> '' and length(print_label) <= 40)

doctor_profile_claims_decision.name: doctor_profile_claims_decision
doctor_profile_claims_decision.value:
(status in ('PENDING','NEEDS_INFORMATION') and decided_at is null)
          or (status in ('APPROVED','REJECTED','CANCELLED') and decided_at is not null)

doctor_subscriptions_discount.name: doctor_subscriptions_discount
doctor_subscriptions_discount.value: founder_discount_percent is null or founder_discount_percent between 0 and 100

encounters_one_draft_per_appointment.name: encounters_one_draft_per_appointment
encounters_one_draft_per_appointment.where: status = 'DRAFT' and appointment_id is not null

encounters_height_range.name: encounters_height_range
encounters_height_range.value:
vital_height_cm is null
      or (vital_height_cm > 0 and vital_height_cm <= 300)

encounters_weight_range.name: encounters_weight_range
encounters_weight_range.value:
vital_weight_kg is null
      or (vital_weight_kg > 0 and vital_weight_kg <= 700)

encounters_temperature_range.name: encounters_temperature_range
encounters_temperature_range.value:
vital_temperature_c is null
      or (vital_temperature_c >= 10 and vital_temperature_c <= 50)

encounters_pulse_range.name: encounters_pulse_range
encounters_pulse_range.value:
vital_pulse_bpm is null
      or (vital_pulse_bpm > 0 and vital_pulse_bpm <= 400)

encounters_systolic_range.name: encounters_systolic_range
encounters_systolic_range.value:
vital_systolic is null
      or (vital_systolic > 0 and vital_systolic <= 400)

encounters_diastolic_range.name: encounters_diastolic_range
encounters_diastolic_range.value:
vital_diastolic is null
      or (vital_diastolic > 0 and vital_diastolic <= 300)

encounters_resp_rate_range.name: encounters_resp_rate_range
encounters_resp_rate_range.value:
vital_resp_rate is null
      or (vital_resp_rate > 0 and vital_resp_rate <= 200)

encounters_spo2_range.name: encounters_spo2_range
encounters_spo2_range.value:
vital_spo2 is null
      or (vital_spo2 >= 0 and vital_spo2 <= 100)

patient_documents_archive_consistent.name: patient_documents_archive_consistent
patient_documents_archive_consistent.value:
(archived_at is null and archived_by is null and archive_reason is null)
          or (archived_at is not null)

platform_owners_revocation.name: platform_owners_revocation
platform_owners_revocation.value: (is_active = true and revoked_at is null) or (is_active = false and revoked_at is not null)

prescriptions_finalized_is_complete.name: prescriptions_finalized_is_complete
prescriptions_finalized_is_complete.value:
status <> 'FINALIZED' or (
        finalized_at is not null
        and snapshot_schema_version is not null
        and review_bundle_snapshot is not null
        and review_bundle_snapshot ? 'clinicalDate'
        and doctor_snapshot is not null
        and location_snapshot is not null
        and patient_snapshot is not null
        and template_snapshot is not null
        and items_snapshot is not null
        and review_digest is not null
      )

prescriptions_replacement_has_reason.name: prescriptions_replacement_has_reason
prescriptions_replacement_has_reason.value: replaces_prescription_id is null or replacement_reason is not null

prescriptions_replacement_reason_length.name: prescriptions_replacement_reason_length
prescriptions_replacement_reason_length.value: replacement_reason is null or char_length(btrim(replacement_reason)) between 1 and 500
